best_idea: Refuse input above a per-session cap inside a fixed window, count refused input too, drop it without forwarding, and tell the client, so the engine never applies a flood.
decision_why: Take the reject-and-report intake pattern, but set the cap per server tick in the fight engine as data, because a duel needs a few presses per second and the donor's 80 per second is a chat-server number enforced only at the network edge.
acceptance: A server test sends 40 attack presses in one tick; only the per-tick budget is applied, the rest get a too-fast reply, and duel state changes only for applied presses.
